verses.original: נָ֣סוּ וְאֵין־ רֹדֵ֣ף רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים כִּכְפִ֥יר יִבְטָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: nā·sū wə·’ên- rō·ḏêp̄ rā·šā‘ wə·ṣad·dî·qîm kiḵ·p̄îr yiḇ·ṭāḥ
verses.literal: The wicked flee when no one pursues but the righteous are as bold as a lion

verses.original: בְּפֶ֣שַֽׁע אֶ֭רֶץ רַבִּ֣ים שָׂרֶ֑יהָ וּבְאָדָ֥ם מֵבִ֥ין יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ כֵּ֣ן יַאֲרִֽיךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄e·ša‘ ’e·reṣ rab·bîm śā·re·hā ū·ḇə·’ā·ḏām mê·ḇîn yō·ḏê·a‘ kên ya·’ă·rîḵ
verses.literal: A land in rebellion has many rulers but a man of understanding and knowledge maintains order

verses.original: גֶּ֣בֶר רָ֭שׁ וְעֹשֵׁ֣ק דַּלִּ֑ים מָטָ֥ר סֹ֝חֵ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ge·ḇer rāš wə·‘ō·šêq dal·lîm mā·ṭār sō·ḥêp̄ wə·’ên lā·ḥem
verses.literal: A destitute leader who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain that leaves no food

verses.original: עֹזְבֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָה יְהַֽלְל֣וּ רָשָׁ֑ע וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י ת֝וֹרָ֗ה יִתְגָּ֥רוּ בָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·zə·ḇê ṯō·w·rāh yə·hal·lū rā·šā‘ wə·šō·mə·rê ṯō·w·rāh yiṯ·gā·rū ḇām
verses.literal: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked but those who keep the law resist them

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁי־ רָ֭ע לֹא־ יָבִ֣ינוּ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּמְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָבִ֥ינוּ כֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê- rā‘ lō- yā·ḇî·nū miš·pāṭ ū·mə·ḇaq·šê Yah·weh yā·ḇî·nū ḵōl
verses.literal: Evil men do not understand justice but those who seek the LORD comprehend fully

verses.original: טֽוֹב־ רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם וְה֣וּא עָשִֽׁיר׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- rāš hō·w·lêḵ bə·ṯum·mōw mê·‘iq·qêš də·rā·ḵa·yim wə·hū ‘ā·šîr
verses.literal: Better a poor man who walks with integrity than a rich man whose ways . . . are perverse

verses.original: נוֹצֵ֣ר תּ֭וֹרָה בֵּ֣ן מֵבִ֑ין וְרֹעֶה זֽ֝וֹלְלִ֗ים יַכְלִ֥ים אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: nō·w·ṣêr tō·w·rāh bên mê·ḇîn wə·rō·‘eh zō·wl·lîm yaḵ·lîm ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: A discerning son keeps the law but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father

verses.original: מַרְבֶּ֣ה ה֭וֹנוֹ בְּנֶ֣שֶׁךְ וּבְתַרְבִּית לְחוֹנֵ֖ן דַּלִּ֣ים יִקְבְּצֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mar·beh hō·w·nōw bə·ne·šeḵ ū·ḇə·ṯar·bīṯ lə·ḥō·w·nên dal·lîm yiq·bə·ṣen·nū
verses.literal: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury lays it up for one who is kind to the poor

verses.original: מֵסִ֣יר אָ֭זְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ תּוֹרָ֑ה גַּֽם־ תְּ֝פִלָּת֗וֹ תּוֹעֵבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·sîr ’ā·zə·nōw miš·šə·mō·a‘ tō·w·rāh gam- tə·p̄il·lā·ṯōw tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh
verses.literal: Whoever turns his ear away from hearing the law even his prayer is detestable

verses.original: מַשְׁגֶּ֤ה יְשָׁרִ֨ים׀ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ רָ֗ע בִּשְׁחוּת֥וֹ הֽוּא־ יִפּ֑וֹל וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִנְחֲלוּ־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: maš·geh yə·šā·rîm bə·ḏe·reḵ rā‘ biš·ḥū·ṯōw hū- yip·pō·wl ū·ṯə·mî·mîm yin·ḥă·lū- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: He who leads the upright along the path of evil will fall into his own pit but the blameless will inherit what is good

verses.original: חָכָ֣ם בְּ֭עֵינָיו אִ֣ישׁ עָשִׁ֑יר וְדַ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין יַחְקְרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵām bə·‘ê·nāw ’îš ‘ā·šîr wə·ḏal mê·ḇîn yaḥ·qə·ren·nū
verses.literal: A rich man is wise in his own eyes but a poor man with discernment sees through him

verses.original: בַּעֲלֹ֣ץ צַ֭דִּיקִים רַבָּ֣ה תִפְאָ֑רֶת וּבְק֥וּם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְחֻפַּ֥שׂ אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·lōṣ ṣad·dî·qîm rab·bāh ṯip̄·’ā·reṯ ū·ḇə·qūm rə·šā·‘îm yə·ḥup·paś ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: When the righteous triumph there is great glory but when the wicked rise men hide themselves

verses.original: מְכַסֶּ֣ה פְ֭שָׁעָיו לֹ֣א יַצְלִ֑יחַ וּמוֹדֶ֖ה וְעֹזֵ֣ב יְרֻחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḵas·seh p̄ə·šā·‘āw lō yaṣ·lî·aḥ ū·mō·w·ḏeh wə·‘ō·zêḇ yə·ru·ḥām
verses.literal: He who conceals his sins will not prosper but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מְפַחֵ֣ד תָּמִ֑יד וּמַקְשֶׁ֥ה לִ֝בּ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ’ā·ḏām mə·p̄a·ḥêḏ tā·mîḏ ū·maq·šeh lib·bōw yip·pō·wl bə·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: Blessed is the man who is always reverent but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble

verses.original: אֲרִי־ נֹ֭הֵם וְדֹ֣ב שׁוֹקֵ֑ק מֹשֵׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע עַ֣ל עַם־ דָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·rî- nō·hêm wə·ḏōḇ šō·w·qêq mō·šêl rā·šā‘ ‘al ‘am- dāl
verses.literal: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people

verses.original: נָגִ֗יד חֲסַ֣ר תְּ֭בוּנוֹת וְרַ֥ב מַעֲשַׁקּ֑וֹת שֹׂנְאֵי בֶ֝֗צַע יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: nā·ḡîḏ ḥă·sar tə·ḇū·nō·wṯ wə·raḇ ma·‘ă·šaq·qō·wṯ śō·nə·ʾē ḇe·ṣa‘ ya·’ă·rîḵ yā·mîm
verses.literal: A leader who lacks judgment is also a great oppressor but he who hates dishonest profit will prolong his days

verses.original: אָ֭דָם עָשֻׁ֣ק בְּדַם־ נָפֶשׁ עַד־ בּ֥וֹר יָ֝נ֗וּס אַל־ יִתְמְכוּ־ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām ‘ā·šuq bə·ḏam- nå̄·p̄ɛš ‘aḏ- bō·wr yā·nūs ’al- yiṯ·mə·ḵū- ḇōw
verses.literal: A man burdened by bloodguilt . . . will flee into the Pit let no one support him

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים יִוָּשֵׁ֑עַ וְנֶעְקַ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם יִפּ֥וֹל בְּאֶחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·lêḵ tā·mîm yiw·wā·šê·a‘ wə·ne‘·qaš də·rā·ḵa·yim yip·pō·wl bə·’e·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: He who walks with integrity will be kept safe but whoever is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־ לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֥ף רֵ֝קִ֗ים יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־ רִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw yiś·ba‘- lā·ḥem ū·mə·rad·dêp̄ rê·qîm yiś·ba‘- rîš
verses.literal: The one who works his land will have plenty of food but whoever chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אֱ֭מוּנוֹת רַב־ בְּרָכ֑וֹת וְאָ֥ץ לְ֝הַעֲשִׁ֗יר לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’ĕ·mū·nō·wṯ raḇ- bə·rā·ḵō·wṯ wə·’āṣ lə·ha·‘ă·šîr lō yin·nā·qeh
verses.literal: A faithful man will abound with blessings but one eager to be rich will not go unpunished

verses.original: הַֽכֵּר־ פָּנִ֥ים לֹא־ ט֑וֹב וְעַל־ פַּת־ לֶ֝֗חֶם יִפְשַׁע־ גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kêr- pā·nîm lō- ṭō·wḇ wə·‘al- paṯ- le·ḥem yip̄·ša‘- gā·ḇer
verses.literal: To show partiality . . . is not good yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread

verses.original: נִֽבֳהָ֥ל לַה֗וֹן אִ֭ישׁ רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְלֹֽא־ יֵ֝דַע כִּי־ חֶ֥סֶר יְבֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ni·ḇo·hāl la·hō·wn ’îš ra‘ ‘ā·yin wə·lō- yê·ḏa‘ kî- ḥe·ser yə·ḇō·’en·nū
verses.literal: A stingy . . . man hastens after wealth and does not know that poverty awaits him

verses.original: מ֘וֹכִ֤יחַ אָדָ֣ם אַ֭חֲרַי חֵ֣ן יִמְצָ֑א מִֽמַּחֲלִ֥יק לָשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: mō·w·ḵî·aḥ ’ā·ḏām ’a·ḥă·ray ḥên yim·ṣā mim·ma·ḥă·lîq lā·šō·wn
verses.literal: He who rebukes a man will later find more favor than one who flatters with his tongue

verses.original: גּוֹזֵ֤ל׀ אָ֘בִ֤יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ וְאֹמֵ֥ר אֵֽין־ פָּ֑שַׁע חָבֵ֥ר ה֝֗וּא לְאִ֣ישׁ מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: gō·w·zêl ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw wə·’ō·mêr ’ên- pā·ša‘ ḥā·ḇêr hū lə·’îš maš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: He who robs his father or mother saying It is not wrong is a companion . . . to the man who destroys

verses.original: רְחַב־ נֶ֭פֶשׁ יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ עַל־ יְהוָ֣ה יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ḥaḇ- ne·p̄eš yə·ḡā·reh mā·ḏō·wn ū·ḇō·w·ṭê·aḥ ‘al- Yah·weh yə·ḏuš·šān
verses.literal: A greedy man . . . stirs up strife but he who trusts in the LORD will prosper

verses.original: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭לִבּוֹ ה֣וּא כְסִ֑יל וְהוֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּ֝חָכְמָ֗ה ה֣וּא יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: bō·w·ṭê·aḥ bə·lib·bōw hū ḵə·sîl wə·hō·w·lêḵ bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh hū yim·mā·lêṭ
verses.literal: He who trusts in himself . . . is a fool but one who walks in wisdom . . . will be safe

verses.original: נוֹתֵ֣ן לָ֭רָשׁ אֵ֣ין מַחְס֑וֹר וּמַעְלִ֥ים עֵ֝ינָ֗יו רַב־ מְאֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: nō·w·ṯên lā·rāš ’ên maḥ·sō·wr ū·ma‘·lîm ‘ê·nāw raḇ- mə·’ê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Whoever gives to the poor will not be in need but he who hides his eyes will receive many curses

verses.original: בְּק֣וּם רְ֭שָׁעִים יִסָּתֵ֣ר אָדָ֑ם וּ֝בְאָבְדָ֗ם יִרְבּ֥וּ צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·qūm rə·šā·‘îm yis·sā·ṯêr ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·’ā·ḇə·ḏām yir·bū ṣad·dî·qîm
verses.literal: When the wicked come to power people hide themselves but when they perish the righteous flourish
